file: 239 Geometry Dash Now Shows You Every Place You Died.mp4

lines.t: Geometry Dash can now show you every single place you died.

full.credit: Clips: RobTop Games (2.209 trailer); Colours Gaming (YouTube)

lines.t: Update 2.209 came out on October 16th. Platformer levels finally save your progress.

full.credit: Clips: RobTop Games (2.209 trailer); Colours Gaming (YouTube)

lines.t: There's a death tracker, with markers on every spot you died. And you can set your own keybinds.

full.credit: Clips: RobTop Games (2.209 trailer); Colours Gaming (YouTube)

lines.t: Plus group chats, emojis, and a new song by meganeko.

full.credit: Clips: RobTop Games (2.209 trailer); Colours Gaming (YouTube)
